mechanism: Propylthiouracil-induced hypothyroidism can enhance beta-2 adrenergic receptor sensitivity and increase cardiovascular effects of albuterol; additionally, hyperthyroidism (which PTU treats) increases albuterol sensitivity and tachycardia risk.
action: Monitor heart rate and cardiac symptoms; thyroid function should be maintained within normal range; consider dose adjustment of albuterol if excessive tachycardia or tremor occurs.
